dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned sentiment, length, ratings and helpfulness feed descriptive and logistic relations.
Topic words define five aspect vocabularies for similarity scoring.
Weighted six-index brand profiles feed system clustering.
Monthly sentiment and rating fields form reputation.
Dated reputation/review histories define lagged feedback inputs.
The baseline reputation weights and AR coefficients feed sensitivity.
Candidate brand clusters feed product-parent recommendations.
Sensitivity and assessment bound memo confidence.
